correctness.rationale: For every detector outcome in the polarization-preserving photon-count analyzer, phi+ and phi− differ only by phase between orthogonal same-polarization sectors, so their joint outcome probabilities agree. Thus MAP Bell-label success sums to at most 1/4 for the unresolved phi pair and at most 1/2 for psi±; the 50:50 analyzer attains 3/4. The ideal teleportation Bell label has uniform prior independently of the input, and a wrong Pauli correction of Haar-uniform pure qubit gives mean squared Bloch coordinate 1/3. Therefore Fbar=(1+2pMAP)/3≤5/6, equality at 50:50. Independent exact Fraction check 3/4+1/4·1/3=5/6. I inspected the source’s verifier; its rational arithmetic is secondary to the structural polarization argument.
